title: UCP Core
introBefore: Agents don’t need the whole thread — they need verifiable context. UCP is an open format: a long discussion collapses into a package of facts, decisions, and conflicts — far fewer tokens, with provenance. Spec and toolchain:
features: Spend tokens on signal, not noise: up to ~15× smaller on long threads — decisions and sources intact.
Trust what you ship: every claim cites sources, every source carries sha256, schema-validated before write.
Fits where you already work: MCP for Cursor and Claude Code, REST for your pipelines — one self-hosted server.
Closes the quality loop: Usage Receipts show what the agent actually used — the next brief ranks sharper.
Works without an LLM: structure carries the facts; the model is optional for what’s buried only in prose.
One contract for humans and models: summary, must_know, decisions, conflicts — predictable in every consumer.
footer: UCP · context you can trust in production
